name: Lotta Greer
source_profile:
Lotta Greer (CN) — Proprietor of the Gilded Anchor

Lotta is a sharp-tongued former river trader who has operated the Gilded Anchor for many years. Her establishment has become one of Westbridge's most popular gathering places, attracting sailors, merchants, gamblers, river pilots, and passing adventurers.

A shrewd businesswoman with an extraordinary memory for names and faces, Lotta possesses an extensive network of acquaintances throughout the waterfront. She knows which vessels have arrived, which merchants are quarreling, and which captains have suddenly become wealthier than their recent voyages would seem to justify.

Lotta maintains cordial relations with Sheriff Bram Eddows, whom she has known since his years as a river pilot. Although she generally cooperates with legitimate criminal investigations, she is reluctant to surrender information that might endanger the confidence of her customers.

She is particularly skeptical of the River Spurs, whose officers occasionally visit the Anchor seeking information about suspected smugglers and wanted pirates. Lotta considers their methods unnecessarily heavy-handed and has little patience for officers who assume that every river trader is a criminal.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 129 (source excerpt; may be partial)
